meta.name: cultural-adaptation
meta.description: Adapting AI behavior for different cultural contexts, languages, and norms.

copy.tagline: 调整AI行为适配不同文化语境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同文化背景下使用AI助手
copy.tagline_en: Adapt AI behavior to different cultural contexts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to work across different cultures and languages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会根据你的文化背景调整语言风格、正式程度和沟通方式，例如使用合适的敬语或直接/间接的表达。
howto.when: 当你与Claude对话时，它会根据你所在的文化语境自动调整回应方式，不需要额外指令。

say.note: Claude会切换为更礼貌、使用敬语的风格。

say.text: 以间接的方式给出建议。
say.note: Claude会避免直接否定，使用委婉措辞。
Claude会使用适合中国语境的例子和表达。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude adapts its language style, formality, and communication approach based on your cultural background, such as using proper honorifics or direct/indirect expression.
howto.when_en: It activates automatically during conversations, adjusting responses to align with the cultural context of the user.

say_en.text: Please respond in a formal tone.
say_en.note: Claude switches to more polite and honorific language.

say_en.text: Give advice in an indirect way.
say_en.note: Claude avoids direct refusals and uses euphemisms.

say_en.text: Refer to Chinese culture in your response.
say_en.note: Claude uses examples and expressions relevant to Chinese context.
